reasoning: I ranked teams on recent tier-1 form, weighted heavily toward the Esports World Cup (the only verifiable like-for-like table, and the most recent major). Team Vision, Yandex and BoomBoys form the top layer: EWC podium plus 2026 titles. Spirit sits with them despite a modest EWC — a two-time TI winner with a clean European qualifier and a documented history of peaking on the TI patch. Falcons are defending champions with an unchanged roster but a mediocre year and a 0-2 EWC quarterfinal exit to Vici; I keep them upper-middle rather than top. Liquid, Aurora, Vici and Xtreme are the volatile middle: Aurora collect runner-up finishes without titles, Vici's EWC fourth is real but from a single event, Xtreme underperformed at EWC yet remain the strongest Chinese org on home soil. Nigma, 1win and LGD are coinflips to advance; LGD are downgraded because Topson has not played competitively since TI 2024 and joined days before the event, which is a serious drag on a Bo1-heavy Swiss opening. OG and Resilience are below-median, Resilience unrated at tier-1 as a unit. HULIGANI and GamerLegion are clear bottom: last place at EWC and no top-eight tier-1 results respectively. Swiss with Bo1 early rounds compresses everything — even the best team is only ~11-12% to run 4-0, and no team is above ~72% to advance or below ~15%. Champion odds are advance probability times a conditional strength factor, with a bump for Spirit and Falcons (Bo5 playoff pedigree) and a discount for teams whose resume rests on one deep run. The heavy mass in w4_l2 and w2_l4 reflects that the format's middle buckets hold ten of sixteen teams.
